actionConfiguration.body: SELECT COUNT(reserva001_id) AS ocupacao_atual FROM "{{JSutils.currentSchema()}}".hotreserva001 WHERE reserva001_deleted <> true AND reserva001_acomo001_id = {{ appsmith.store.reservaContexto.acomo001_id }} AND reserva001_situacao NOT IN (3, 4) AND reserva001_checkin < '{{ appsmith.store.reservaContexto.checkout }}' AND reserva001_checkout > '{{ appsmith.store.reservaContexto.checkin }}';
